name: Max HP / Max MP growth per class and level
status: Confirmed (MeowDB states it was measured/confirmed in COT2)
status_note: Per-level HP/MP gain is a flat number based on your class. First, second, and third job advancements grant the same class bonus. Every figure below is measured from COT2, including a level 11 Warrior catch-up and Grummash's level 100 third-job characters.
random_range_note: All five classes are confirmed. Sampled level-ups showed zero variance.

starting.note: A character starts with 50 base HP and 5 base MP. A Beginner at level 10 has 194 HP and 113 MP.

branches_use_base_class_rates: Branches use their base class rates. Hunter and Crossbowman take the Bowman numbers, Bandit and Assassin take the Thief numbers.
formulas: A = 1 + [2nd job at Lv 30+] + [3rd job at Lv 70+]
JobHP = 50 + 16 × B + HPAdv × A + HPPerLevel × C
JobMP = 5 + 12 × B + MPAdv × A + MPPerLevel × C
percent_bonus_rule: The percentage skill applies after the flat bonus, then the result rounds down.
int_gives_mp_note: INT does not give additional MP here.
hp_washing_note: HP washing is dead in MSCW.
ap_into_hp_mp_note: MeowDB documents no rule (allowed or not, gain per AP) for spending AP on Max HP or Max MP. The HP/MP formulas above have no AP term, the Beginner's guide and the formulas tab describe AP only as STR/DEX/INT/LUK points, and the HP/MP guide says HP washing is dead. The glossary, however, says AP is "used to raise STR / DEX / INT / LUK / HP / MP" and that Max HP/MP gets "a small AP contribution". See discrepancies.
job_advancement_heal_note: Unlike leveling up, job advancing does not heal you. It only raises your max HP and MP.
late_advancement_note: A level 11 Beginner advanced to Warrior with 572 Max HP, 275 Max MP, all Warrior skills at rank 0, and 4 unspent SP. Those are the same base pools and first-job SP as an on-time level 11 Warrior.
late_advancement_caveat: This directly confirms level 11 Warrior catch-up; later levels and other classes still need direct tests.
equipment_and_skills_note: Equipment can provide additional HP and MP. Warriors and magicians carry a skill: Max HP Increase and Max MP Increase each reach +25% (of your base) at max level.

parity_examples.note: late advancement from a level 11 Beginner

gaps: Rule for putting AP into Max HP / Max MP (allowed or not, and the gain per AP) is not documented on MeowDB.
How much a level-up heals (full HP/MP or not) is not stated; only implied by "Unlike leveling up, job advancing does not heal you".

values.text: Max HP/MP goes up with level, plus a small AP contribution.
AP: Earned at every level up. You get 5 per level. Used to raise STR / DEX / INT / LUK / HP / MP.
HP washing is dead in MSCW. INT does not give additional MP here. (No AP term in any HP/MP formula.)
then get 5 AP per level for STR, DEX, INT, and LUK.

discrepancies.chosen: No AP term (ap_into_hp_mp = null); AP is allocated to STR/DEX/INT/LUK only
discrepancies.reason: The HP/MP guide is the dedicated, COT2-measured mechanics page (measured level-ups with zero variance) and the Beginner's guide (updated 2026-10-02) lists only the four stats; the glossary entries are one-line definitions. Unresolved: whether AP can be put into Max HP / Max MP, and how much it gives, remains a gap.
